purpose: Prevent exploratory, failed, or protocol-invalid runs from being cited as publication evidence while preserving every artifact.

entries.reason: The causal gravity estimate was restarted at ground-truth activity-label boundaries. Those boundaries are unavailable at inference time and therefore influenced preprocessing.

The neural controls consumed FoG-STAR signals produced by the label-boundary-dependent gravity preprocessing implementation.

Physical filtering no longer reset at label changes, but the classical prediction helper still accepted held-out labels to construct a discarded report. Predictions were label-independent; the stricter replacement removes labels from the prediction API and adds launch-time source hashes.

The selected model did not use held-out labels, but its inference loader unnecessarily computed label-derived sample weights that were then ignored. The replacement inference dataset has no label or weight channel and adds launch-time source hashes.

The run passed strict label isolation and evidence validation, but preceded the repository formatter gate. The formatted-source replacement reproduced all hard predictions and scores; probability differences were no larger than floating-point roundoff.
